summary: Iter 24 tested end-to-end: (a) backend Discover/Home feed ordering & priority, hard distance filter, unlimited mode, is_online tracking, and the 4 required Mongo indexes; (b) frontend F3 persistent auto-session (LandingOrHome), (c) frontend F2 PWA install banner mobile-only + dismiss+localStorage persistence. All 6 pytest cases pass. All targeted frontend flows pass. Zero console errors observed.

backend_test_results.test_discover_feed_online_first: PASS - online candidates (is_online=true, last_active=now) sort ahead of offline (last_active=2020) in /discover/feed
backend_test_results.test_home_feed_hard_filter_limited: PASS - viewer at (55.75,37.61) with distance_mode=limited distance_km=50 -> ~29km candidate included, ~250km candidate hidden
backend_test_results.test_home_feed_priority_tiers: PASS - order Online+Premium < Online+Nearby < Offline+Nearby < Offline+Far

frontend_test_results.F3_no_token_shows_landing: PASS - visiting / without lovreski_token shows Login form (Войти/пароль fields visible)
frontend_test_results.F3_with_token_redirects_home: PASS - after fetch /api/auth/login and localStorage.setItem, visiting / auto-navigates to /home
frontend_test_results.F3_reload_persists: PASS - full reload on /home stays on /home
frontend_test_results.F3_logout_clears_and_lands_on_landing: PASS - Settings logout clears lovreski_token; next visit to / shows Landing
frontend_test_results.F2_mobile_banner_visible: PASS - iPhone UA + /home renders data-testid=pwa-install-banner with 'Install Lovreski App / for a better experience' + pwa-install-btn + pwa-install-dismiss
frontend_test_results.F2_mobile_dismiss_persists: PASS - clicking pwa-install-dismiss hides banner, sets localStorage.lovreski_pwa_dismissed='1', banner stays hidden after reload
frontend_test_results.F2_desktop_hidden: PASS - desktop UA on /home does NOT show banner even without dismiss flag
frontend_test_results.F1_F2_grid_and_swipe_render: PASS - /home shows 6 profile cards (data-testid=profile-card-*), /discover renders swipe card(s) with data-testid=swipe-*

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/register (line 390) IGNORES the request body's show_me and always sets show_me to the opposite gender. This is unrelated to iter24 but caused initial test failures - main agent should decide whether registration should honor client-provided show_me.
_base_candidates uses hard pool_limit=500/800. For a large user base future-scaling should consider Mongo aggregation with tier scoring instead of Python in-memory sort.
HomePage.jsx shouldShowInstallBanner runs on module init via useState default, plus a beforeinstallprompt listener; both correctly re-check the dismiss localStorage flag - looks solid.
test_credentials: testuser1@lovreski.ru / password123 works. Registration requires field 'dob' (YYYY-MM-DD); backend overrides show_me based on gender.
seed_data_creation: Test suite registers ephemeral users with prefix tst_iter24_* and cleans up via teardown_module. Mongo is /app/backend/.env test_database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter24 is fully green. When registering users via /api/auth/register: (1) dob is REQUIRED (YYYY-MM-DD), (2) show_me is overridden by backend (male->female, female->male), so to add candidates matching a viewer with show_me='both', explicitly set viewer show_me='both' AND set candidate gender to what the viewer wants in Mongo. Home feed default limit=6 & discover=20; use limit>=500 in tests since demo data has ~178 users. Local MongoDB test_database is shared with the preview backend.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in scope.
